'''Union Sportive Boulogne Côte d'Opale''' ({{IPA|fr|ynjɔ̃ spɔʁtiv bulɔɲ kot dɔpal|-|}}; commonly referred to as '''US Boulogne''', '''USBCO''' ({{IPA|fr|y.ɛs.be.se.o|-|}}) or frequently, simply '''Boulogne''') is a [[Football in France|French association football]] club based in the [[Communes of France|commune]] of [[Boulogne-sur-Mer]]. The club was founded in 1898 and currently plays in [[Ligue 2]], the second level of [[French football]], having been promoted from the [[Championnat National]] at the end of [[2024–25 Championnat National|2024–25 season]] due to AC Ajaccio being relegated for financial reasons.

The club was formed in 1898 and its achievements are comparatively minor, with their biggest feat to date consisting of reaching the semi-finals during the 1936–37 edition of the [[Coupe de France]], and one [[Ligue 1]] season in [[2009–10 Ligue 1|2009–10]]. Boulogne play their home matches at the [[Stade de la Libération]], which seats 15,004, having previously seated only 7,000 prior to its renovation in 2007."}}
